header.title: How to Diagnose a Dishwasher Leak
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to diagnose the source of a dishwasher leak. By systematically checking gaskets, hoses, the water inlet valve, and water level, you can identify and potentially resolve the issue.

steps.description: This step involves inspecting the dishwasher door gasket for tears and testing its seal by attempting to slide paper between the door and the gasket.
actions: Visually inspect the gasket for any tears.
Insert a piece of notebook or newspaper at the top portion of the door along the side.
Close the door on the paper.
Gently pull the paper out of the door.
Open the door.
Move the paper to the next space.
Repeat steps 3-6 along both sides of the dishwasher.

steps.description: This step involves inspecting the dishwasher hoses for leaks by removing the kick plate and checking for wetness and damage.
actions: Turn off the power at the breaker.
Remove the kick plate.
Locate the screws holding the kickplate in place.
See the inlet solenoid valve with the fill hose attached.
Feel the hose for water.
Shine a flashlight or trouble light underneath to spot water.
Locate the drain hose (usually from the back).
Remove screws fastening the top part of the dishwasher to the cabinet (if necessary).
Pull out the dishwasher.
Feel and look for wet spots on the drain hose.
Look near the connection points.
Look on the floor under the connection points.
Tighten the clamp if the hose is leaking at a connection point.
Feel the hose for cracks or holes if there is moisture on the hose.
steps.part: Hoses (fill hose, drain hose, inlet solenoid valve)

steps.description: Inspect the water inlet valve for leaks, and replace it if necessary.
actions: Check the water inlet valve
Inspect for water leaks around the valve
Replace the valve if leaking

steps.description: Check the dishwasher's water level after it fills to ensure it's not too high, which could indicate a clog.
actions: Turn the dishwasher on
Let the dishwasher fill
Listen for the water to shut off
Open the dishwasher door
Check the water level
Check the dishwasher for clogs
